axes: Unity space, metres. Origin = the city centre on the ground (city floor y = 0).

lod.note: Grid step per LOD = step x the chunk's stepFactors (edge chunks have half the detail). Skirts hang 10 m down from every chunk edge, so LOD seams show no cracks.

collider: Mesh collider from each chunk's LOD0 mesh.

backdrop.note: Far scenery out to 20 km (mountains, the canyon bending away, the megacity skyline beyond the walls). No colliders; outside the flight bounds. Hide its far edge with fog.

atmosphere.note: Suggested exponential distance fog (the previews use the same numbers): factor = 1 - exp(-(distance - start) / scale).
